scope: Replace the NGE level-DPS/HP/armor creature factory with explicit Publish 14.1 Core3 creature damage, HAM, accuracy, XP, and difficulty profiles while retaining post-Publish-14 zones and content through PRE-CU-derived level fallbacks.

runtimePolicy.exactCreature: Use the pinned Core3 template profile by creature key.
runtimePolicy.renamedCreature: Use a deterministic exact alias based on normalized tokens plus a minimal reviewed alias set.
runtimePolicy.expansionCreature: Use the PRE-CU profile derived from safe Core3 profiles at the retained expansion creature level; no NGE stat_balance DPS, HP, Action, Mind, XP, or armor value participates.
runtimePolicy.explicitLevelOverride: Use the bounded PRE-CU level fallback for the requested level, matching Core3's level-scaling intent without returning to NGE stat_balance.
runtimePolicy.ham: Randomize Health, Action, and Mind independently between Core3 baseHAM and baseHAMmax; secondary attributes are one tenth of their primary pool.
runtimePolicy.accuracy: Convert Core3 chanceHit to the server skill-mod percentage representation.
runtimePolicy.cadence: AI attack execution is gated by the Core3 two-second interval, with the last completed interval retained outside queue entries so retargeting cannot cancel it.
runtimePolicy.creatureArmor: Retire NGE level-table general protection. Existing per-damage-type creature-table protections remain until the separate Core3 armor-rating/resistance remap is completed.

harvestClosure.finalExtractionGate: The resource extraction primitive rejects a player inventory owner without Novice Scout.
retainedRoutes: non-corpse resource systems such as fishing, shellfish, and lair eggs

diagnosis.aiCadenceEvidence: An initial 117-event sample showed a 2.265-second minimum, but an expanded 1,219-event sample exposed two 0.746-second same-owner attacks during target changes. The server now retains the last completed interval independently of queue state; rebuilt live proof remains pending.
diagnosis.remainingLethalityCause: SWGSource create.initializeCreature still multiplied NGE stat_balance damagePerSecond by weapon speed and assigned NGE level-table HAM and armor.
diagnosis.clientReverseEngineering: Not required for server-authoritative attack timing or creature damage. Revisit only if server cadence is correct and client animation presentation remains misleading.

buildEvidence.deployment: synchronized, compiled, healthy, player-ready, and live process mapped to the newly built SwgGameServer

required: newly spawned starter creature reports its Core3 profile values
player attack telemetry confirms the authoritative player weapon interval
non-Scout character cannot obtain creature resources from a corpse
Novice Scout character can harvest the same creature family

requiredBeforeReady: live starter-creature damage and player-cadence acceptance
